SELECT extends.user_id AS user_id, extends.avatar AS avatar_url, extends.mobile AS phone, extends.nickname AS nike_name, extends.first_login_time AS first_login_time, extends.last_deal_time AS last_deal_time, extends.integral AS integral, extends.consume_num AS consume_num, extends.consume_totle_money AS consume_totle_money, extends.user_id AS shop_user_id, ( extends.supply_bonus + extends.rebate_bonus ) AS supply_bonus FROM t_mini_account_extends AS extends WHERE extends.is_deleted = 0 AND extends.is_blacklist = 1 AND extends.shop_id = #{paramMap.shopId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT rest.id FROM t_mini_account_restrict AS rest WHERE rest.user_id = extends.user_id AND rest.restrict_type = #{paramMap.permission} AND rest.is_deleted = 0)
AND ( LOCATE(#{paramMap.fuzzy},dat.nickname) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{paramMap.fuzzy},extends.mobile) > 0 )
ORDER BY extends.join_blacklist_time DESC

SELECT extends.id as id, extends.shop_id as shop_id, extends.create_time as create_time, extends.mobile as phone, extends.first_user_id, extends.user_id as user_id, extends.nickname as nike_name, extends.avatar as avatar_url, extends.first_login_time as first_login_time, 1 as whether_authorization FROM t_mini_account_extends AS extends WHERE extends.user_id = #{shopUserId}

select (select count(*) from t_mini_account_extends t where t.first_user_id = #{shopUserId} and t.is_deleted = 0 and t.shop_id = #{shopId}) as distribution_user_count, (select ifnull(sum(r.use_balance),0) from t_member_balance_record r where r.shop_user_id = #{shopUserId} and r.deal_type = 4 and r.is_deleted = 0 and r.shop_id = #{shopId}) as total_distribution_amount from dual
